headline: One photo, 2 different works
reasons: The same photo file (fingerprint 0a4ab4199244) is attached to 2 different works in 1 village. A photo of one site cannot be evidence for 2 separate works.

This file is not a photograph of a work: it is a 720 x 960 pixel image such as a broken-image icon or a plain graphic. The portal shows this same image as the evidence photo for all 2 works, so none of them has a photo of the site in this slot.
The works are recorded as: Contour Trench (2).
All 2 works report the same GPS point (20.753155, 81.295805).
The photo was uploaded 2 times within 50 seconds (2026-05-31 03:14:18 to 2026-05-31 03:15:08).
